title: The Snake That Flattens Its Body to Fly

scenes.text: Snakes have no wings. This one still glides.
The paradise tree snake launches from branches over fifty feet up.
In the air, it spreads its ribs and flattens into a UFO shape.
Scientists tested models of its body in a water tunnel.
The flat shape gives better lift than its round body.
A snake that flies by turning into a frisbee.

description:
Snakes have no wings. This one still glides.
Paradise tree snakes flatten their bodies into a UFO-like shape in the air, and researchers found that shape works better for gliding than a round body.
Would you want one landing near you? Comment below.
first_comment: Flying snake or flying squirrel: which is cooler?
